To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
increased leptin-induced activation of B cells to induce proinflammatory cytokine secretion is associated with human aging.
leptin-induced activation of B cells and cytokine secretion is increased in aged humans as compared with young controls.
leptin-induced activation and cytokine production by B cells is significantly increased in aged humans.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of B cell activation and cytokine production by leptin and the role of B cells and cytokines in the pathogenesis of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
the role of B cells and the cytokines they produce in inflammation and autoimmunty.
the regulation of immune response in aging and the underlying mechanisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

leptin activates human B cells from aged subjects to induce significantly greater amount of proinflammatory (IL-6 and TNF-α) and anti-inflammatory cytokine (IL-10) as compared to B cells from young humans.
leptin induces activation of B cells from aged subjects, and increased production of pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokine.
leptin-induced activation of B cells may contribute to chronic inflammation and autoantibody production in aged humans.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

leptin is a proinflammatory cytokine that induces secretion of proinflammation cytokines and anti-inflammatory cytokine by B cells, and this is associated with increased activation of B cells and STAT3.
leptin induces B cell activation and cytokine production in aged humans.
leptin induces B cells to secrete proinflammatory and regulatory cytokines in young and elderly humans.
The main takeaway from our work is that
leptin is involved in the regulation of inflammation in aging.
B cells are activated by leptin and that this activation is greater in B cells from the aged as compared to the young.
B cells are activated and induce more cytokines by leptin in aged as compared to young humans.
